mapper.update: UPDATE evaluation SET status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, auditor_id = #{auditorId}, audit_time = GETDATE() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id,object_type,object_id,user_id,score,content,status,reject_reason,create_time,audit_time,auditor_id FROM [evaluation] WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waitCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejectCount FROM [evaluation]

choose.when: UPDATE community SET avg_score = ISNULL((SELECT AVG(score) FROM [evaluation] WHERE object_type = 'community' AND object_id = #{objectId} AND status = 1), 0) WHERE community_id = #{objectId}
UPDATE facility SET avg_score = ISNULL((SELECT AVG(score) FROM [evaluation] WHERE object_type = 'facility' AND object_id = #{objectId} AND status = 1), 0) WHERE facility_id = #{objectId}
